component.name: Folia
component.summary: Lyrics-focused online and local music player

description.p: Folia is a fullscreen lyrics-first music player built on Electron. It supports online music playback, local music libraries, lyrics matching, LRC file recognition, Now Playing integration, and AI-generated visual themes.

ul.li: Online search and playback: search songs, artists, or albums and auto-load covers and lyrics
Local music support: import local audio files; index data is stored locally and never uploaded
Smart lyric matching: auto-match online lyrics and covers for local songs, with manual correction
Local lyric file recognition: auto-load same-directory .lrc, .vtt, .ttml, .qrc, .yrc, .krc, or embedded LRC
Now Playing integration: consume timeline and lyric info from an external player via the local service
AI theme generation: immersive backgrounds and visual parameters based on song mood and lyric content
